split.boundary_rule: Split before filtering, feature extraction, lagging, or normalization. Fit learned transforms on export_train_interval only. Process each exported interval independently. Offline inference may use the full current interval, but no transform may read across roles. The fixed 1000-sample guard on each side removes immediate boundary neighbors; it does not establish independence between recordings or subjects.

evaluation.per_finger_metric: Pearson correlation between predicted and observed flexion across time
evaluation.aggregate: Arithmetic mean of 12 correlations: four fingers for each of three subjects.
evaluation.undefined_correlation_policy: Reject nonfinite predictions or constant predicted/true scored trajectories.

evaluation_boundary: Public preparation reads only train_data and train_dg. Owner-only export may read test_data and the organizers' later-published labels into a separate evaluator directory. Agent staging contains only Train/Valid. Test requires a frozen artifact and never participates in model selection. This is runtime/source isolation, not a private-source Test claim.
